title: [Radio’ Clock] Tea Time Monday with Lee Geun-mook (이근묵)
description:
TV속에 나오는 연예인들 만큼이나 바쁘고 정신없고 중요한 사람들이죠?
연예인들이 일에 집중할 수 있도록 뒤에서 챙겨주고, 도와주는 매니저!
이근묵 매니저님과 함께 했습니다!

방송에서 볼 수 없는 모습, 매니저라는 직업에 대한 다양한 궁금증에 대해서 들어볼 수 있던 재미있는 시간이었는데요!

애슐리와 함께 일했던 매니저에서 지금은 본부장님이 되었다는데요!
오랜 시간이 지났지만 두 분의 케미는 여전한거같죠?!

Just like celebrities appearing on TV, managers are as busy, hectic, and important. 
We had the pleasure of being with Artist Manager Lee Geun-mook,
who takes care of and assists celebrities so that they can focus on their work! 

It was an interesting time where we could learn about various curiosities 
about the profession of being a manager that we don't get to see on broadcasts!

The manager who used to work with Ashley has now become the chief manager! 
It has been a long time, but it seems like the chemistry between the two of them is still going strong, right?!
